products.title: Bobbie Organic Infant Formula - 14.1 oz
products.body_html:
USDA Organic infant formula modeled after breast milk and the EU recipe standard.

Ingredients: Organic Reduced Minerals Whey, Organic Lactose, Organic Vegetable Oils (Organic Sunflower Oil, Organic Soy Oil, Organic Coconut Oil), Organic Nonfat Milk, Organic Galactooligosaccharides, less than 2% of: Calcium Carbonate, Magnesium Phosphate, Choline Bitartrate, Potassium Citrate, Sodium Selenate.

Toddler formula for 12+ months. Organic, non-GMO.
